player_prompt.intro:
Weksi d Imɣad {player_id} deg talmudt n Tadussan.
Tekkiɣ tafat, d talmudt-ik d akken ad t-ɣiwed ad yaweḍ ɣer tafat-ik.
Tafat d yigawsiwen ikffen tettɣay deg tura:
	+ {resource_value_list}
Deg yal talmudt, tekkiɣ ad t-nejmaɣ d argaz-ik akk d ad t-kecmeḍ assebded.
Sken assebded n yisekrafen:
  - '[Assebded: 3 n Iɣil, 2 n Iɣer: -> 5 n Tibrin, 2 n Iɣil]': [Assebded: Iɣawsiwen yefkayen -> Iɣawsiwen isnanayen]
  - '[Accept]': Ad yaweḍ assebded agejdan.
  - '[Deny]': Ad t-kecmeḍ assebded agejdan (asɣan).
Talmudt tettili d {max_turns} n talmudin deg yal asebdad.
